what: ledger_room.split.split_page: one box per voucher on scanned pages that hold several vouchers
data: 107 real scanned A4 pages of one small company's petty-cash vouchers (336 hand-drawn boxes). PRIVATE: used with the owner's consent for aggregate numbers only; no image, name or value is in this repository.
heldout_rule: sorted page file names; index % 3 == 2 is held out, the rest is dev
tuning: every threshold was set on the dev pages only; the held-out pages were run once, after the method was frozen, and that first run is the number reported
matching: greedy one-to-one by IoU; a key box counts as found at IoU >= 0.5; matched_iou_0.7 is the stricter count; a page is fully right when every key box is found and no box is left over
code: ledger_room/split.py sha256 8d1bc0cf9590ee0d7992d91c072896420bd14861ee0632a3b4752c56d610c080 (frozen before the held-out run; unchanged in this commit)
not_done: boxes only: crops are not turned upright (the key's rotate field is not scored); split_page is not called by the pipeline yet
seen_failures_heldout: looked at only after the first held-out run: touching vouchers with no blank band between them (e-invoice strips side by side, stacked postage receipts); small receipts in a dense grid; sideways bills cut in two along their blank middle; a pen note joined to the voucher next to it
